subject.title: Telegram voice message delayed ~15 minutes before agent dispatch, then run aborts

question: What latency threshold, polling recovery action, and user-visible aborted-turn fallback should Telegram use for delayed voice-message dispatches?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing when to restart/alert and what to tell users after an aborted voice turn changes runtime behavior and needs maintainer intent plus live proof.

options.title: Keep Open For Policy And Live Repro
options.body: Require a maintainer-approved threshold/fallback design and a Telegram live or restart-replay reproduction before queuing implementation.

options.title: Scope To Ingress Latency Only
options.body: Implement telemetry and diagnostics first, leaving aborted-turn user messaging to a separate canonical delivery issue.

options.title: Fold Fallback Into Voice Delivery Work
options.body: Keep this issue focused on dispatch delay and let #91652 or another delivery issue own generated-response/no-reply fallback semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Policy And Live Repro
recommendation.body: Require a maintainer-approved threshold/fallback design and a Telegram live or restart-replay reproduction before queuing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh is the best available routing candidate for the polling watchdog and spooled replay half of the behavior from the feature-history evidence.
